parsed.why: Governor's order fixes sex at birth and backs single-sex facilities; surgery-gated IDs, youth-care ban, sports ban, no state gender-identity hate-crime or bias statute. Documented custody harm: trans woman celled with male sex offender, claims dismissed. No criminal bathroom law documented.

Statutory bathroom bans (schools, campus extension), binary-sex statute, felony youth-care ban, surgery-only ID, hate-crime law excluding gender identity, no statewide accommodations recourse. Violence figure is an undercount floor, so unused. Slightly less documented state harm than slot 1.

Act 619 makes trans bathroom/locker use a misdemeanour where a minor is present, K-12 ban extended 2025, first-in-country enforceable youth-care ban, X markers rescinded, no gender-identity hate-crime or discrimination law, religious care refusal. Worst-policy tier.

Unique 2026 law criminalises trans restroom/changing use in government buildings AND public-facing private businesses, first offence up to a year; injunction outcome unresolved. Universal exposure every traveller carrying a mismatched marker across restaurants, hospitals, transit.

Most-protective tier: statewide GENDA accommodations/employment coverage, gender-identity hate-crime law, shield statute, gender-neutral bathroom mandate, X markers, panic-defence repeal. National border, visa and custody regime still governs entry, holding it below Reduced Risk.
